title: 7 Claude prompts that replace a junior hire
caption: Seven Claude prompts that quietly do the work you'd hand a junior. Save this.

slides.title: The research synthesizer
slides.body: "Here are 6 articles (pasted). Give me the 3 claims they agree on, the 2 they contradict on, and the 1 nobody is saying out loud." An afternoon of reading in 90 seconds.

slides.title: The code reviewer
slides.body: "Review this for bugs, security holes, and the one design choice you'd push back on in a real PR. Be blunt." Catches what tired eyes miss.

slides.title: The doc-from-notes
slides.body: "Turn these messy notes into a doc a new teammate could follow with zero context. Flag every place I assumed knowledge."

slides.title: The meeting-to-action
slides.body: "From this transcript: decisions, owners, deadlines, and the unresolved thing everyone avoided. Table format."

slides.title: The competitor teardown
slides.body: "Here's a competitor's landing page. What are they promising, who are they NOT for, and the gap I could own?"

slides.title: The explain-it-back
slides.body: "Explain my own code/plan back to me as if you're skeptical it works. Where would it break first?" The cheapest QA you'll ever run.

slides.title: The edge-case finder
slides.body: "List the 10 inputs most likely to break this, ranked by how embarrassing the failure would be in production."
